title: engineering-all-hands-2026-04-22
content:
Engineering All-Hands — 2026-04-22
Owner: Jordan Kim
Attendees (presented / major contributors): Ava Patel, Diego Morales, Priya Shah, Liam O'Connor + org
Duration: 60m
Location: Zoom / recording linked above

Agenda:
- Company updates recap (quick)
- Platform metrics (latency, throughput, cost)
- Major launches / rollouts (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private)
- SRE & reliability update (incidents, oncall changes)
- Feature deep-dive: Smart routing improvements
- Q&A and action items

1) Company / product highlights (Maya gave quick 3-min summary):
- Series C momentum continues; a few enterprise deals closed in EMEA last week (CS follow-up ongoing).
- Product: Redwood Optimize beta now onboarding 10 customers; early feedback positive for batching suggestions.

2) Platform metrics (Ava) — week over week (2026-04-15 -> 2026-04-21):
- 99th p50 token latency (hosted): 42ms -> 40ms (improvement after kernel patch)
- Avg tokens/s per GPU (in Dedicated pools): 1.8k -> 1.95k (better packing)
- Cache hit rate (prefix/KV): 12% -> 15% (new caching heuristic in canary)
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $0.68 -> $0.64 (quantization + batching improvements)
Notes: still seeing tail latency spikes tied to bursts from a particular customer; infra team investigating blob migration timings.

3) Rollouts & launches (Diego)
- Hosted API: streaming v2 rollout at 40% of traffic, no regressions observed. Next week we'll move to 60% if no issues.
- Dedicated: autoscaling policy ETA for GA (customer config UI + backend) -> targeted 2026-05-06. Need final runbook sign-off from SRE.
- Private: first on-prem pilot (fintech customer) completed integration tests; minor KMS integration tweaks planned.

4) SRE / reliability (Priya)
- Incident recap: 2026-04-18 outage (partial, 18m) caused by hot-shard leader election during maintenance window. Root cause: leader election timeout config too low when combined with network jitter.
  - Actions taken: reverted maintenance, increased election timeout, added automatic rollback for new leader-election-wide patches.
  - Postmortem in progress: JIRA PLAT-4823 assigned to Priya + infra; draft due 2026-04-25.
- Oncall rotation change: starting 2026-05-01, second-week escalation moved to oncall-2 to reduce fatigue.

5) Feature deep-dive: Smart routing improvements (Liam)
- Motivation: reduce cost while maintaining latency SLOs by routing to model variants and regions dynamically.
- What shipped in canary: policy engine that evaluates (latency, cost, region affinity, model-compat) and chooses candidate routes.
- Early canary results: 8% avg cost reduction for mixed workloads, 3% increase in median latency (within SLO).
- Known limitations: session stickiness for KV cache not yet implemented (leads to small quality regressions for multi-turn chat).
- Next steps: implement session affinity (PR #1287); integrate fallback policies for incompatible model variants.

6) Developer experience & observability (Ava / Diego)
- Console: new per-route token cost breakout now in beta for internal customers.
- Alerts: added a new class of alerts for cache-thrashing patterns; will tune thresholds next week.

7) Hiring & org notes
- Platform-engineering hiring: 3 backend SWE offers extended, interviewing for 2 more infra roles.
- Team offsite: scheduled 2026-06-04 to 2026-06-06 (logistics: Concur + travel approvals).

8) Open Q&A (selected)
- Q: Will smart routing support custom customer policies? A: Yes — roadmap includes customer-level policy override by Q3.
- Q: Any changes to SDK rate limits? A: No immediate changes; traffic shaping improvements aim to avoid per-customer throttles.

9) Action items / owners (short list)
- Priya: postmortem draft for 2026-04-18 outage (JIRA PLAT-4823) — due 2026-04-25.
- Diego + Product: finalize Dedicated autoscale runbook and sign-off — due 2026-05-01.
- Liam: PR #1287 (session affinity) code review & canary plan — target merge 2026-04-28.
- Ava: tune cache-thrashing alerts + publish tuning notes — due 2026-04-27.

Notes to self / informal:
- Reminder: follow up with CS on EMEA customer feedback re: Private deployment onboarding docs — seems like we need clearer network diagram.
- Question for next all-hands: add a short demo of Optimize suggestions flow.

Links / references: see linked artifacts above.

Minutes compiled by Jordan Kim. Small edits made 2026-04-23 (typos, added links).
